modules.cost: Specifications and proofs erase. The separate borrowed-slice packing/extraction implementation is functionally refined under explicit canonical coefficient and slot preconditions, with pinned same-source runtime and semantic-mutation evidence. Erased loop counters prove exact copied, written and zeroed word totals; a pinned optimized release-code comparison confirms the counters add no instructions. Narrow independent API review and local consumer measurement-evidence review passed. Formal bit/peak-space accounting and product-composition refinement remain open; no automatic dispatch or universal performance claim.

modules.cost: Source performs no allocation. Erased loop counters prove exact pack word totals: count*coefficient_limbs copied, count*slot_limbs written and count*(slot_limbs-coefficient_limbs) zeroed. Extraction copies count*coefficient_limbs words and reads no guard padding. Pinned -O release bodies before and after adding ghost counters are byte-identical: pack 140 instructions/487 bytes (SHA-256 84df6810c854bd5dd0fe25d5a7d38abed7d18ab11176932ef2135216672953f6), extract 101 instructions/324 bytes (SHA-256 45155a3921293655560a5c6a32a36c461ca92731112f696aea64492c9e26104c). Formal bit/peak-space bounds and composed product refinement remain open. Two independent measured consumer runs show shape-dependent tradeoffs only; no automatic dispatch, universal performance, solver speedup or GMP-parity claim.
